description: The pisiform is a pea-shaped carpal that rides atop the triquetrum, acting as a sesamoid guide for the ulnar side of the wrist.

landmarks.name: Pisiform apex
landmarks.desc: Distal point that presses against the palmar skin and receives the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon.

landmarks.name: Palmar face
landmarks.desc: Rounded anterior surface that bulks the hypothenar heel and shields ulnar nerve structures.

landmarks.name: Ulnar articular face
landmarks.desc: Posterior facet where the pisiform glides over the triquetrum to maintain wrist alignment.
